name: Game Event Creature Data
description: Temporarily overrides a creature spawn's template entry, display model, equipment and vendor list while a game event is active; optional spells are cast on the creature when the event starts and ends.

fields.name: Guid
fields.help: Creature spawn guid from the creature table.

fields.name: Entry Id
fields.help: Alternative creature_template entry the creature is updated to while the event is active. 0 = keep the original entry.

fields.name: Model Id
fields.help: Display id (CreatureDisplayInfo.dbc) used while the event is active. 0 = no model change.

fields.name: Equipment Id
fields.help: creature_equip_template entry used while the event is active. 0 = no equipment change.

fields.name: Vendor Id
fields.help: npc_vendor_template entry the creature offers as vendor while the event is active. 0 = no vendor change.

fields.name: Spell Start
fields.help: Spell cast on the creature when the event starts (typically an aura kept while the event is active). 0 = none.

fields.name: Spell End
fields.help: Spell cast on the creature when the event stops. 0 = none.

fields.name: Event
fields.help: Game event id (game_event.entry) during which this override is applied. Only positive ids are allowed here.
